name: Bitter Lesson (Scale)
description: Rich Sutton's thesis that scaling compute, data, and model capacity reliably beats clever engineering. Dominated AI strategy from 2017-2025 and drove the rise of OpenAI/Anthropic, but the author argues the second half of the decade calls for a different bet.

edges.quote: religiously following this bet is how companies like OpenAI and Anthropic have exploded in valuation since
the obsession over 'raw model capability' has ironically led to our evaluation metrics being completely off
